name: exchange-card
title: ExchangeCard
description: Request / response card: a small uppercase head ("Request" with the example name, "Response" with a filled status like "200 OK") over stacked mono blocks (request line, parameters in warning, headers muted, body). Exchange lays a pair side by side with a ⇄ between them. Used on Service (example detail) and Copilot (generated examples).

a11y.pattern: <section aria-label> per card; each block is a <pre role="region" aria-label tabindex="0"> so a wide block can scroll with the keyboard
keyboard: Scroll a focused block that overflows
aria: The card is named ("Request of Eclair Cafe")
The status is written text ("200 OK"); its fill only speeds up scanning
The ⇄ between the cards is decorative (aria-hidden)
